subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2, audit logs, DPA & next steps (Acme Corp)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2, audit logs, DPA & next steps (Acme Corp)

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and the items we agreed to follow up on: 

1) Primary pain points you described
- Auditability: need searchable, tamper-evident audit logs for admin and end-user actions (90-day and 7-year retention lanes per internal policy).
- Data residency & retention: certain data subsets must be retained on US hosts and have configurable retention/erasure windows.
- Compliance evidence: SOC 2 report, recent pen test summary, and DPA required for procurement review.

2) Goals
- Proof of controls (SOC 2 Type II) to satisfy InfoSec gate by next Friday (2026-03-05).
- Provide high-level architecture and where logs are stored, plus options for longer-term retention/exports.
- Deliver DPA and indicate any standard redlines or timeline for signature.

3) Agreed next steps
- We will send SOC 2 report and a one-page pen test summary (Marissa) — by EOD Friday 2026-02-27.
- Provide log retention architecture and the export/CSV workflow (Dev) — by Mon 2026-03-01.
- Legal/procurement to receive DPA and draft redlines; we can use DocuSign for execution (Marissa/Soojin).
- Follow-up demo focused on audit/logging and retention features (we suggested Tues 2026-03-02).

If I missed anything or the priority/timeline should shift, let me know. I pasted the action owners above so we have clear ownership.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2, audit logs, DPA & next steps (Acme Corp)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. That aligns with our needs. A few clarifications from our side:

- SOC 2: procurement will need the most recent SOC 2 Type II report and an index of which systems are in scope.
- Pen test: a one-page executive summary is fine to start; later we may request the full findings under an NDA.
- Retention: ability to set retention by dataset is important (especially for PII). Also please confirm if Redwood supports export of raw logs for long-term archival (S3/CSV).
- DPA: procurement asked that you share your standard DPA and any expected timeline for signatures. Our legal is typically quick but wants to see standard redlines up front.

Can you send the SOC 2 + pen test summary and DPA link? If you can get the SOC 2 to us by EOD tomorrow (2026-02-27) that would be ideal; otherwise early Monday is acceptable.

Thanks —
Jordan Smith
Director, InfoSec | Acme Corp
jordan.smith@acme.com | +1 212-555-0123

Jordan —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Attaching the items we discussed:
- SOC2_Report_Q3_2025.pdf [Attachment: SOC2_Report_Q3_2025.pdf (pdf, 2MB)]
- pen_test_summary_2024.pdf [Attachment: pen_test_summary_2024.pdf (pdf, 450KB)]

High level on logging/retention:
- Audit logs: immutable event stream stored in our US logging cluster (AES-256 at rest). Logs are searchable in the Console and can be exported to customer S3 buckets on a daily cadence (CSV/NDJSON).
- Retention: retention windows are configurable per dataset and per route; we support short-term (90 days), medium (2 years), and long-term (7 years) retention policies. We also provide a deletion API for on-demand erasure to meet GDPR/CCPA requests.
- Exports: full raw-log exports are supported; we can set up an automated export to your S3 by the end of the week once we have the target bucket + IAM role.

DPA: Soojin (legal) is looped here to share our standard DPA and next steps for signatures. Soojin — can you please share the DPA link and any expected review timeline? We can also push the DocuSign powerform if that speeds procurement.

Proposed next meeting: 2026-03-02 at 10:00 AM PT for a 30m technical demo covering audit logs and retention flows. Please tell me if that works and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Marissa
